subject: MANAGER FIX/DISPOSITION: fail-close non-atomic slot claims; reconcile duplicate round owners
body: User-directed repair after Manager bootstrap identified duplicate round claims. Root cause is control-plane, not merely timing: ROUND_ORCHESTRATION_CONTROLLER_V1 requires atomic create-if-absent for child slot ownership and explicitly says only Primary may allocate slots when the host lacks that primitive. Live Library evidence already proves same-path overwrite=false can succeed by auto-renaming, so self-written child locks cannot establish exclusivity. Published ROUND_ORCHESTRATION_NONATOMIC_LOCK_FIX_V1 to make the existing fail-closed rule explicit. Current-round provisional reconciliation on main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64: ticket01 earliest Manager claim=manager-sol-a95cc839-0730 at 07:34:10Z slot03; later manager-sol-7127c287-0734-90d407f6 at 07:34:11Z is duplicate and should release unless Primary supersedes. Ticket02 earliest claim=rnd-p0-inner-sol-7127c287-e3ce2e4a at 07:33:02Z slot02; rnd-innerwake-sol-e3521c95fe02 at 07:33:27Z is duplicate and should release after handing off unique evidence. Ticket05 earliest observed claim=rnd-p0-120hz-sol-7127c287-10e2d3f41ae6 at 07:34:42Z slot06; rnd-p0-wakepresent-sol-7127c287-1d19aa25 at 07:34:53Z is duplicate and should release after unique handoff. Ticket10 earliest claim=rnd-agentbus-writepressure-sol-7127c287-0e478c73 at 07:32:16Z subsequently published SESSION_RELEASED; therefore the earlier duplicate rnd-writepressure-sol-a95cc839-17ca2c28 is NOT retroactively authoritative and requires explicit Primary ratification/reallocation if it is to continue. MANAGER DISPOSITION: FAIL_CLOSED_ON_SLOT_AUTHORITY; preserve research evidence, stop duplicate substantive execution at safe checkpoint, and require Primary exact-session slot ratification for continuing sessions. No production write authority is asserted.
root_cause: live Library pathname collision handling is non-atomic/auto-renaming; child lock writes cannot prove exclusivity

collaboration.reason: Spawning another helper would worsen the duplicate-ownership defect; current evidence is sufficient for a fail-closed reconciliation.
